# Membership evidence batch 01 — historical submission

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**


WorkBuddy agent (AI), 24 October 2026, 21:30–22:10 Beijing time. Scope: 1980–2024. This batch collected proposals; it did not publish membership rules, rerun Q1, change production inputs or commit/push.

The batch covered 24 of 148 task keys and proposed outcomes for 193 distinct matches: 139 member-only, four non-member-only and 50 unresolved/conflicting. These are proposals about target associations, not 139 automatically restored study matches. None were resolved under the primary-FIFA-evidence requirement.

The original README's “22 teams” and task-state totals were corrected by the [independent batch review](../../../../../outputs/logs/team_identity/batch-review-20261024-batch01/README.en.md): 21 source teams; 17 partial, 13 conflict and two not_found are 32 assessment rows, not 24 task states. The one-state-per-task totals are nine partial, 13 conflict and two not_found.

Main leads concerned East Germany, the 1994 Congress, China's decision/approval dates, Lithuanian restoration, Montenegro, South Africa, Croatia, Palestine and Slovenia. Dates from news, UEFA or national associations remained leads; political events or an annual membership year could not establish precise FIFA status.

The folder retains `evidence.jsonl`, `claims.jsonl`, `case_assessments.jsonl`, `search_log.jsonl` and source files. There were 11 evidence records, 26 claims, 32 assessments and nine search rows; nine new originals were stored, while a FIFA annual report was reused. Image-only or blocked sources were explicitly limited to search excerpts; missing dates remained null.

Recorded checks covered parsing, ID links, task/match membership and source hashes. No human or second-agent review, complete pytest, production publication or new statistics occurred. See the original source README for detailed leads and the review for corrections. Today's adopted sample is described in the [identity guide](../../../../../研究/00_数据再次确认/README.en.md), not this draft.

Original preserved file: [README.md](README.md). This reading edition does not replace its registered evidence.
